HF15
Scan on startup is a persisted option and can be disabled.
When startup scanning is disabled, UNCANNY opens from cached/manual entries without discovery.
Manual Add game entries are authoritative, persist across reboot, and do not require a boot scan.
Windows short/long path aliases are canonicalized before manual-library deduplication.
Per-target BuildId update detection, full-stack Remove, rollback, PCSX2, REVENANT and DLSS 5 routing are preserved.
Adaptive Realism includes shared scene evidence, split contact/diffuse lighting, Emissive Bounce Guard, Black Floor Intelligence, asymmetric local contrast, Legacy Cinema Reconstruction v2 and High/Insane Depth Material Sculpt.
Motion Guard and Ghosting Guard remain authoritative. X2.5 retains the lowest temporal-history weight.

LIMITATIONS
Real-game visual/performance acceptance remains title/GPU/driver specific.
Adaptive Realism is vendor-neutral; the optional DLSS 5 route remains NVIDIA-specific.
D3D12/D3D9 use conservative fallbacks when trustworthy generic scene depth is unavailable.
